reports.title: Enerpac Tool Group Reports Fourth Quarter and Full-Year Fiscal 2026 Results; Introduces Fiscal 2027 Outlook

guidance.heading: Fiscal 2027 Outlook
section: “Our fiscal 2027 guidance includes approximately 10 months of SFE Group and builds on the healthy trends across our business,” added Darren Kozik, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer. “We are excited to drive profitable growth through continued investments in commercial excellence, innovation, and productivity.”
